subject.title: v2026.6.x system prompt bloat causes instruction following degradation on smaller models

question: Should OpenClaw solve this smaller-model instruction-following regression by changing prompt/source priority and skill-loading policy, by routing it into the broader context compactor work, or by documenting it as a model/backend limitation with existing opt-in mitigations?
rationale: The evidence shows partial mitigations but no single narrow bug fix; choosing between prompt priority, context compaction, tool scoping, skill loading, and documentation changes is a product/default compatibility decision.

options.title: Design priority-aware prompt policy
options.body: Keep this issue open and define how explicit user instructions, activated skill content, workspace files, and platform rules should be ordered or scoped before changing defaults.

options.title: Fold into compactor work
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90349 as the broader product vehicle if maintainers want one context-budget feature to own prompt bloat, skills, memory, tools, and compactness levels.

options.title: Document as backend limitation
options.body: Close after documenting `localModelLean`, tool profiles, and `supportsTools: false` as the supported path if MiMo-like priority failures are outside the compatibility target.

recommendation.title: Design priority-aware prompt policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define how explicit user instructions, activated skill content, workspace files, and platform rules should be ordered or scoped before changing defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent related lean-mode work and docs updates make this the strongest available owner for the product-direction choice.
